hardness_profile.label: compressed_junction
hardness_profile.mechanism: four unsignalized approaches reach one conflict zone together
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: one entry or stop changes the remaining three connector windows

hardness_profile.label: high_speed_junction
hardness_profile.mechanism: high-speed approaches leave little reaction time at the junction
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: late braking propagates through the junction and route-aligned NPCs

hardness_profile.label: tight_priority_window
hardness_profile.mechanism: all four agents arrive in a narrow priority window
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: one blocked connector changes the discharge order for the whole group

hardness_profile.label: conservative_release
hardness_profile.mechanism: slow approaches create a long shared occupancy interval
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: a cautious first decision delays peers and local native traffic

hardness_profile.label: last_second_entry
hardness_profile.mechanism: agents commit to the unsignalized junction with minimal clearance
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: a late stop can block all four approaches and the NPC cohort

hardness_profile.label: tight_left_gap
hardness_profile.mechanism: the left turn meets a three-car opposing stream in a short gap
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: the lead through vehicle changes the gap seen by the next two peers

hardness_profile.label: fast_opposing_stream
hardness_profile.mechanism: a fast opposing stream closes the left-turn window quickly
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: turn hesitation backs up the focal lane while the stream discharges

hardness_profile.label: mixed_stream
hardness_profile.mechanism: the turning vehicle meets a tightly spaced opposing platoon
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: one peer's yield changes TTC and headway for the following peers

hardness_profile.label: high_speed_turn
hardness_profile.mechanism: both turning and through movements approach the conflict quickly
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: a conservative turn creates a queue that delays crossing traffic

hardness_profile.label: near_simultaneous_stream
hardness_profile.mechanism: three through vehicles reach the conflict as a compact stream
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: the first peer's action changes all later through-vehicle headways

hardness_profile.label: fast_lead
hardness_profile.mechanism: a fast lead vehicle reaches the merge before ego can settle
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: lead occupancy changes ego's gap choice and follower braking

hardness_profile.label: fast_followers
hardness_profile.mechanism: fast followers compress the usable gap behind the lead
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: ego timing creates two downstream braking waves in the stream

hardness_profile.label: all_fast
hardness_profile.mechanism: all four agents approach the common merge at high speed
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: an unsafe or delayed merge blocks the connector and raises queue time

hardness_profile.label: fast_ego_slow_stream
hardness_profile.mechanism: ego closes on a slower stream while its target lane is occupied
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: ego braking or entry changes stream order and following queue

hardness_profile.label: speed_mismatch
hardness_profile.mechanism: large speed differences create a moving rather than static gap
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: each peer reacts to a different gap snapshot in a multi-stage wave

hardness_profile.label: blocked_target_lane
hardness_profile.mechanism: the target lane is occupied as ego reaches the merge connector
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: the first merge choice changes all three follower release times

hardness_profile.label: junction_stop_wave
hardness_profile.mechanism: a moderate-speed four-way arrival exposes stop-and-go choices
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: one peer's stop creates a wave through the native cohort

hardness_profile.label: junction_commitment
hardness_profile.mechanism: four agents commit near the same unsignalized entry time
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: connector occupancy of one agent changes all remaining priorities

hardness_profile.label: short_gap_release
hardness_profile.mechanism: a short moving gap separates ego from two fast followers
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: a single lane entry or brake changes the entire local platoon

hardness_profile.label: late_merge
hardness_profile.mechanism: ego reaches the merge after the lead has already committed
hardness_profile.causal_chain_target: late commitment propagates to followers and route-aligned NPCs
